description: This file implements runtime and link-time HLSL shader code generation for Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project, including shader struct generation, output signature creation, and shader linking logic.

classes.name: BuiltinVarying
classes.description: Represents a built-in varying variable with semantic and index information.

classes.name: BuiltinVaryingsD3D
classes.description: Manages built-in varyings for different shader stages based on metadata.

classes.name: BuiltinInfo
classes.description: Holds information about built-in variables for shader stages.

classes.name: DynamicHLSL
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating HLSL shader code dynamically for ANGLE's D3D backend.

methods.name: generateVertexShaderForInputLayout
methods.description: Generates a vertex shader source with input layout and attributes.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForOutputSignature
methods.description: Creates pixel shader output signature code based on output variables and layout.

methods.name: generateGeometryShaderHLSL
methods.description: Generates geometry shader code for different primitive types and configurations.

methods.name: generateVaryingLinkHLSL
methods.description: Creates HLSL code linking varyings between shader stages.

methods.name: generateShaderLinkHLSL
methods.description: Links vertex and fragment shaders into a complete shader program in HLSL.

methods.name: generateComputeShaderForImage2DBindSignature
methods.description: Generates compute shader code for image2D binding signatures.

methods.name: generatePixelShaderForHdrOutputSignature
methods.description: Generates HDR output signature code for pixel shaders (Starboard-specific).

methods.name: GenerateAttributeConversionHLSL
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for attribute type conversion.

methods.name: getPixelShaderOutputKey
methods.description: Determines the output variables for the pixel shader based on program and metadata.
